name: std::isblank(std::locale)

declarations.code:
template <class CharT>

bool isblank(CharT ch, const locale &loc);

intro: Checks if the given character is classified as a blank character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: Returns true if the character is classified as a blank character, false otherwise.

sections.title: Possible implementation

examples.output:
isblank(' ', locale("C")) returned false
isblank(' ', locale("en_US.UTF-8")) returned true

summary: Checks if the given character is classified as a blank character by the given locale's std::ctype facet.
